note: Deadline the user has to appeal, counted from the date on the denial notice unless stated. The app always shows the date it computed AND the rule it used, and asks for the notice date if it cannot read one. If the denial letter states its own deadline, show the letter's deadline and this rule side by side.

plan_types.label: Marketplace / ACA plan
plan_types.next_level: External review by an independent reviewer (state process or federal HHS process). See external_review_states.json.
plan_types.source: 29 CFR 2560.503-1(h)(3)(i) as applied to non-grandfathered individual coverage via 45 CFR 147.136

plan_types.label: Plan through my job

plan_decides_within.pre_service: 30 days (15 per level if two levels)
plan_decides_within.post_service: 60 days (30 per level if two levels)

plan_types.next_level: External review. Fully insured: state process. Self-funded (most large employers): federal process. The denial letter or plan document says which.

plan_types.label: Medicare Advantage
plan_types.next_level: If the plan upholds a denial, it must automatically forward the case to the Independent Review Entity. The user does not file this step.
plan_types.source: CMS, Reconsideration by the Medicare Advantage (Part C) Health Plan

plan_types.label: Original Medicare
plan_types.deadline_runs_from: receipt of the Medicare Summary Notice; receipt is presumed 5 days after the notice date, so the app uses notice date + 125 days and shows the date printed on the MSN if one is there
plan_types.next_level: Reconsideration by a Qualified Independent Contractor (QIC), request within 180 days of the redetermination.

plan_types.label: Medicaid
plan_types.deadline_runs_from: the date on the adverse benefit determination notice
plan_types.next_level: State fair hearing, after the plan upholds the denial. Deadline set by the state; show 'check your notice'.
